descriptions.thermal: Circling and climbing, exploiting a column of rising air.
descriptions.search: Circling to investigate a possible core, often losing altitude until the thermal is found.
descriptions.glide: Transitioning in a straight line and losing altitude, heading toward the next thermal or turnpoint.
descriptions.float: Gliding straight, neutral or slightly climbing: lift bands, ridge soaring, convergence, or crossing a small thermal without stopping.
descriptions.landing: Final low-speed segment as the flight ends.

phasesTab.climbPhaseCount: {count, plural, one {# climb phase} other {# climb phases}}
phasesTab.outcomesTitle: Search outcomes: what came right after each search

typologyDescriptions.stationary: Hovering with little ground progress, typical of ridge soaring or working a static lift source.
typologyDescriptions.linear: Straight-line progression through lift: riding a band, crest, or convergence line.
typologyDescriptions.wandering: Meandering between lift sources: drifting through a soft area with multiple weak inputs.

phasesTab.crossedLiftHint: Float phases where you climbed at {vz} or more for at least 5 s and then continued without circling: moments where a small thermal was crossed but not investigated.
phasesTab.leftRadiusHint: Mean circle radius during left turns
phasesTab.rightRadiusHint: Mean circle radius during right turns
phasesTab.circlesTooShort: Thermal phase too short to complete a full circle

unifiedMap.baroHint: Baro: barometric altitude. Smooth and accurate for relative changes (vario, height gain) but depends on QNH calibration for absolute values.
unifiedMap.gpsHint: GPS: satellite altitude. Independent of QNH calibration; more reliable for absolute altitude reference.
unifiedMap.gFactorInfoBody: <link>G-factor (load factor)</link> represents the vertical load during flight: 1G = straight and level, 1 to 2G = gentle turns, 2 to 5G = aggressive maneuvers.

stats.raceHint: Your timed speed section, from crossing the start (SSS) to reaching the end of the speed section (ESS).
stats.startToGoalHint: Elapsed time from your start until you tagged goal.
stats.taskSpeedHint: Average speed along the optimized distance to ESS, over your race time.
stats.landAfterGoalHint: How long you kept flying after tagging goal before landing.
stats.optimalDistanceHint: The shortest legal line through every turnpoint cylinder, start to goal.
stats.distanceFlownHint: How far you completed along the optimized task line. It is the full distance once goal is reached.
stats.completionHint: Share of the optimized task distance you completed.
stats.startTimeHint: Local clock time when you crossed the start.
stats.startDelayHint: Gap between the start gate opening and your actual start. Less means a more aggressive start.

splits.title: Turnpoint splits
splits.legend: Each leg is shaded along its length by leading-point opportunity. GAP prices a lead by the square of the distance still to fly to ESS, so the fill is greenest right off the start and fades to nothing by ESS. The greener the stretch, the more a push there earns.
